description: This file defines a React component 'LearningPathProgress' that displays user progress within a learning path, including phases and enrollments, with UI elements and state management.

methods.name: getPhaseStatusIcon
methods.description: Returns the appropriate icon component based on the phase status ('completed', 'in_progress', 'locked', or default).

methods.name: getPhaseStatusColor
methods.description: Returns CSS classes for border and background color based on phase status.
